prerequisite: Must run after generate_demolition_design_lines has drawn its lines (and after any manual fixes to special sections such as side slopes)
fixture_requirements: The same survey drawing as extract_measured_sections
Design lines already present on the C3DF-STRIP-LINE / C3DF-CUT-LINE layers
At least 3 consecutive stations on one survey line (verifies adjacent pairing in the average-end-area method)
At least one section whose boundary was edited by hand (verifies the key property 'compute from the lines actually in the drawing')
assertions: Key property: areas are computed from the strip/cut lines actually in the drawing. After narrowing one section's cut line by hand and rerunning, that section's excavation_area shrinks -- the upstream node's in-memory result is not reused
Average end area: per_section strip_volume == (previous station strip_area + this station strip_area) / 2 * spacing; subsoil likewise
The first section of each survey line has spacing = 0 and strip_volume = excavation_volume = 0 (a first section forms no volume)
per_line total_volume == sum of strip_volume + excavation_volume of the sections in the group
Top-level strip_volume / excavation_volume == sum over per_line; total_volume == the two added
Sections are grouped by survey line and sorted by station ascending before pairing (unordered input does not change the result)
Strip area is measured between the ground line and the offset strip segment (the vertical closing legs at both ends are Trimmed off and do not count toward the span)
Subsoil area is measured between the stripped surface and the cut line, not between the original ground and the cut line
A section with no design line in range counts area 0, goes to warnings, and increments sections_without_lines
Design lines are assigned by bounding-box centre falling within the section ground line's bounding box expanded by own_margin
When own_margin is reduced until design lines cannot be assigned to any section, unassigned_strip_lines / unassigned_excavation_lines > 0 and warnings say so (no volume is dropped silently)
own_margin <= 0 throws
Sections whose title text yields no station: area only, spacing=0, excluded from volume, with a 'station unknown' warning
Sections that failed calibration (valid=false) are excluded from the volume table -- currently without a warning; confirm during regression that this is intended rather than an omission
With annotate_sections=true every section gets one text 'strip x m2 subsoil y m2' above it; labels == number of sections
With annotate_sections=false labels == 0 and annotation_layer is not created
Empty text_style uses the drawing default; a non-existent style name throws and suggests running normalize_textstyles first
With annotate_sections=false text_style is not validated (no annotation, so a bad style name must not fail the run)
clear_existing clears only annotation_layer and never touches C3DF-STRIP-LINE / C3DF-CUT-LINE (that would delete the input)
Idempotent: two consecutive runs give identical volumes and labels do not stack
With export_excel=true excel_files is non-empty and the files exist; the last row is a 'Total' row whose volume columns == the top-level summary
excel_format=both writes both xlsx and csv; an invalid value silently falls back to xlsx
When excel_out_path is given its directory and base name are used; otherwise the file lands in outdir (or the ResolveOutDir default if that is absent too)
With export_excel=false excel_files is an empty array and nothing is written
When neither layer holds a design line, throw and suggest running generate_demolition_design_lines first
When no calibrated section matches line_filter, throw and suggest running extract_measured_sections first
